title: CERT Basic Training
description: Disaster medical operations, triage, fire safety, light search and rescue, and team organization. A companion to hands-on CERT training.
citation: Federal Emergency Management Agency. CERT Basic Training Participant Manual. 2019 update.
rightsEvidence: GovInfo identifies FEMA as government author. Downloaded complete federal publication; inspected for copyright notices and third-party restrictions; none found.
usageNote: Training reference; practical rescue and medical skills require qualified instruction.

title: Emergency Manual: Perioperative Crises
description: Interactive reference for 26 surgical and anesthesia crises, with cognitive aids and crisis resource management. For trained clinical teams.
citation: Stanford Anesthesia Cognitive Aid Program (Goldhaber-Fiebert SN, Austin N, Sultan E, Burian BK, Burden A, Howard SK, Gaba DM, Harrison TK). Emergency Manual: Cognitive aids for perioperative crises. Version 4, 2021; downloaded interactive PDF labelled V4.4, 2022. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
rightsEvidence: https://emergencymanual.stanford.edu/downloads/ and the original PDF explicitly permit noncommercial use with attribution under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Original PDF unchanged.
usageNote: Professional reference, not a guide for untrained surgery. Unmodified copy for noncommercial use only; no author or institutional endorsement. Publisher page describes the 2021 revision; this PDF cover is labelled V4.4, 2022.

title: Basic Emergency Care
description: A complete clinical workbook for acute illness and injury in settings with limited resources, including assessment, trauma, breathing problems, and shock.
citation: Basic emergency care: approach to the acutely ill and injured. Geneva: World Health Organization and the International Committee of the Red Cross; 2018. Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO.
rightsEvidence: License on PDF page 4 explicitly permits noncommercial copying and redistribution with citation. Downloaded unmodified from the Medbox humanitarian-library mirror after official hosts returned HTTP 403; title, ISBN, 240-page count and license checked against WHO publication. Illustrations credited as original in acknowledgments.
usageNote: For trained health workers. The 2018 workbook predates the publisher’s November 2025 postpartum haemorrhage update; consult current local protocols and publisher updates. Noncommercial use only; no WHO or ICRC endorsement.

title: Emergency Wound Care
description: A one-page guide to wound care after a natural disaster, infection warning signs, and when to seek medical attention.
citation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Emergency wound care after a natural disaster. October 26, 2017. CS285676-A.
rightsEvidence: CDC-authored fact sheet held in CDC Stacks. No third-party copyright restriction found. Original PDF unchanged.

title: Are You Ready?
description: Household planning, supplies, alerts, evacuation, shelter, and protective actions for a wide range of disasters.
citation: Federal Emergency Management Agency. Are You Ready? An In-Depth Guide to Citizen Preparedness. P-2064. September 2020.
rightsEvidence: Original FEMA federal publication from Ready.gov; FEMA author in PDF metadata. No third-party copyright restriction found.

title: Emergency Drinking Water
description: EPA guidance on disinfecting drinking water during a service interruption, including the limits of boiling and disinfection.
citation: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Office of Water. Emergency Disinfection of Drinking Water. EPA 816-F-15-003. September 2017.
rightsEvidence: Original EPA Office of Water federal publication. EPA author in PDF metadata. No third-party copyright restriction found.

title: Food & Water Safety
description: Planning for power cuts and floods, handling refrigerated and frozen food, and protecting drinking water.
citation: U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Food and Water Safety During Power Outages and Floods. January 2023.
rightsEvidence: FDA website policy permits copying public-domain text and graphics unless otherwise noted. FDA-authored publication with no third-party copyright restriction found.

title: Generator Safety
description: A quick-reference sheet on generator placement and carbon monoxide alarms during a power outage.
citation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. When the Power Goes Out, Keep Your Generator Outside. Original PDF; publisher page reviewed August 21, 2026.
rightsEvidence: CDC-authored fact sheet served by the current CDC Generator Safety page; original PDF unchanged. No third-party copyright restriction found.
usageNote: The PDF itself is undated (file metadata: 2012); the date shown is the publisher page review date.

title: Hurricane & Flood Response Safety
description: A field reference for responders and volunteers covering cleanup hazards, protective equipment, sanitation, heat, fatigue, and psychological stress.
citation: NIOSH. Hurricane and Flood Key Messages for Employers, Workers, and Volunteers, Third Edition. Atlanta, GA: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health. DHHS (NIOSH) Publication No. 2025-106. May 2025.
rightsEvidence: NIOSH government-authored publication. No third-party copyright restriction found. Original PDF unchanged.
usageNote: Links in the PDF lead to additional online material and will require an internet connection.
